zh.overview.title: 记忆空间
zh.overview.description: 由 Mnemon Native 或第三方 Provider 承载的长期记忆；已激活的空间参与召回。
zh.overview.pageDescription: 创建和启停记忆空间，查看每个 Provider 的存储状态与实时关联快照。
zh.overview.interval: 进入时全量同步 · 点击卡片按需同步
zh.overview.fullSyncSeconds: 上次全量同步：{count} 秒前
zh.overview.fullSyncMinutes: 上次全量同步：{count} 分钟前
zh.overview.fullSyncHours: 上次全量同步：{count} 小时前
zh.overview.fullSyncDays: 上次全量同步：{count} 天前
zh.overview.directory.description: 每张卡片是一个记忆空间；点击卡片检查连接，开关决定它是否参与召回。
zh.overview.directoryLoading: 正在加载记忆空间目录
zh.overview.healthLoading: 正在检测各记忆空间状态
zh.overview.reconnectHint: 点击卡片重新检测并同步这个记忆空间
zh.overview.snapshotLoading: 正在加载多记忆空间实时快照
zh.overview.metadataTitle: AI 维护记忆空间元信息
zh.overview.metadataDescription: 选择一个或多个已激活记忆空间。系统会分别通过各 Provider 最快的原生查询路径读取少量样本，再由独立任务 Agent 生成标题与说明。
zh.overview.metadataUnavailable: 暂时无法运行：未找到与当前记忆范围匹配的活跃 Agent
zh.overview.metadataLoading: 正在载入可维护的记忆空间…
zh.overview.metadataEmpty: 当前没有可由 AI 维护元信息的已激活记忆空间。
zh.overview.metadataSelected: 已选择 {count} 个记忆空间
zh.overview.metadataSafety: 仅更新本地标题与说明，不会修改、移动或删除记忆内容。Provider 关闭后，这些本地元数据会随映射一起清理。
zh.overview.metadataCompleted: 已更新 {count} 个记忆空间的元信息。
zh.overview.unsyncedTitle: 记忆空间目录尚未同步
zh.overview.unsyncedShort: 当前 Web 客户端与 DSH Host 状态不一致；重启 Host 后会重新登记既有 Store。
zh.overview.unsyncedLong: 当前 Host 仍在使用旧插件契约；重启 DSH 后会重新发现既有 Store，期间不会删除任何 .db。
zh.overview.emptyShort: 创建第一个记忆空间并写入稳定上下文后，它会出现在这里。
zh.overview.emptyLong: 创建一个 Mnemon 记忆空间，或在“插件 → 可组合记忆”页面启用第三方 Provider 以同步其已有记忆空间。
zh.overview.noActiveText: 开启至少一个记忆空间的读取开关，即可在这里聚合它的实时图谱。
zh.overview.noContentTitle: 已激活记忆空间尚无内容
zh.overview.noContentText: 存入记忆后，这里会显示节点与关系。
zh.overview.createDialogHint: 这里定义记忆空间用途并选择底层 Provider；服务、凭据和全局数据位置沿用“插件 → 可组合记忆”页面中的配置。
zh.overview.createIdentityHint: 名称用于识别；描述会帮助 Agent 判断什么内容应写入和召回。
zh.overview.createPlacementHint: 这是一次明确的手动创建；选择一个已启用 Provider。任务 Agent 新建空间时的选择在“新空间的 Provider”中设置。
zh.overview.createDescriptionPlaceholder: 说明哪些内容属于它，以及何时应被召回
zh.overview.placementManualHint: 直接选择一个已启用 Provider
zh.overview.placementAutomaticHint: 先应用数据边界与能力规则，再由 Agent 在合格候选中选择
zh.overview.placementUnavailable: 需要一个已连接且与当前工作区对齐的对话
zh.overview.placementPolicyHint: 规则由系统强制执行，Prompt 只影响合格候选之间的判断。
zh.overview.placementPromptPlaceholder: 例如：这是团队协作知识；在满足精确写入要求时优先本地，否则优先共享。
zh.overview.candidateNativeReady: 官方原生 · 跟随当前记忆范围
zh.overview.nativeCliRequired: 需要在本机安装 Mnemon CLI；其他 Provider 不受影响
zh.overview.workspaceBinding.optional-overr: 跟随当前范围；全局可自定义位置
zh.overview.candidateOpenViking: 纳入远程候选并提供连接
zh.overview.candidateLocal: 本地 Provider · 跟随当前记忆范围
zh.overview.candidateRemote: 远程 Provider · 使用全局服务配置
zh.overview.providerNativeHint: 官方原生、本地优先，保留完整图谱与软删除能力
zh.strategy.title: 新空间的 Provider
zh.strategy.description: 任务 Agent 需要新建记忆空间时，如何选择 Provider；已有空间仍按名称与说明路由。
zh.strategy.loading: 正在读取 Provider 目录…
zh.strategy.modeHint: 只影响任务 Agent 新建的记忆空间；手动创建时始终由你指定。
zh.strategy.manualHint: 固定使用一个 Provider，Agent 无法改选
zh.strategy.automaticHint: 先执行硬规则，再由任务 Agent 选择合格 Provider
zh.strategy.manualDescription: 当现有记忆空间都不适合时，新记忆空间固定创建在这个 Provider 中。
zh.strategy.automaticDescription: 数据边界与能力要求由主机强制执行，Prompt 只影响合格候选之间的判断。
zh.overview.providerOpenVikingHint: 连接已有 OpenViking 服务，由记忆空间工作流统一调度
zh.overview.providerSummary.mnemon-native: 官方原生、本地优先，保留完整图谱与软删除能力
zh.overview.providerSummary.openviking: 文件系统形态的共享记忆，支持经验证的精确写入与语义召回
zh.overview.providerSummary.honcho: 跨会话用户建模、Peer 档案、辩证推理与持久结论
zh.overview.providerSummary.mem0: 自动事实提取、语义召回、重排与去重
zh.overview.providerSummary.hindsight: 知识图谱记忆，具备实体解析、多策略召回与反思
zh.overview.providerSummary.holographic: 本地结构化事实记忆，支持可信度、实体解析与组合召回
zh.overview.providerSummary.retaindb: 云端混合向量/BM25 召回、用户画像与类型化事实
zh.overview.providerSummary.byterover: 通过 brv CLI 使用的本地优先分层知识树
zh.overview.providerSummary.supermemory: 语义记忆、持久画像、会话摄取与多容器召回
zh.overview.providerApiKeyKeep: 已保存；留空表示保持不变
zh.overview.providerDiscoveryUser: User Key 所属用户（跳过 Admin）
zh.overview.deleteWarning: 该操作会永久删除这个记忆空间及其中的全部记忆与关系，无法撤销。
zh.overview.lastStoreDeleteHint: Mnemon 需要保留至少一个原生 Store；可将最后一个记忆空间设为未激活，但不能删除。
zh.overview.disconnectWarning: 这里只会从 DSH 记忆空间目录移除 {provider} 连接；底层引擎中的记忆不会被删除。
zh.overview.snapshotSourcesHint: 真实关系图、无边内容投影和查询型记忆空间分别呈现，不伪造 Provider 不具备的关系。
zh.overview.noVisualTitle: 当前记忆空间只支持按需查询
zh.overview.noVisualText: 这些 Provider 不提供可枚举内容或图谱；请前往“检索”输入明确问题。
zh.overview.graphComposition: {spaces} 个空间 · {memories} 条记忆 · {entities} 个实体
zh.overview.selectNodeText: 查看记忆空间、实体或记忆的精确上下文。
zh.overview.loading: 正在同步多记忆空间实时快照…
zh.graph.aria: Mnemon 实时记忆图谱，{nodes} 个元素，{edges} 条连接
zh.search.title: 检索记忆
zh.search.description: 在已激活的记忆空间中检索：直接检索返回原文，Agent 查询给出带引用的回答。
zh.search.placeholder: 为什么选用 SQLite？这个项目有哪些发布约定？
zh.search.startText: 聚焦实体、决策或时间线，比批量加载整库更可靠。
zh.search.emptyText: 换一个更具体的实体、决策或时间线关键词试试。
zh.search.noRelated: 没有找到两跳内的关联节点。
zh.entities.title: 实体查阅
zh.entities.description: 查看实体在事实、决策与上下文之间的关联。
zh.entities.unsupportedTitle: 没有支持实体索引的记忆空间
zh.entities.unsupportedText: 当前激活 Provider 仍可通过“检索”召回，但不会在这里伪装成实体图谱。
zh.entities.filterHint: 输入时即时过滤左侧列表（按 Esc 清空）
zh.entities.emptyRail: 写入带实体的记忆后，这里会形成入口。
zh.entities.filterEmpty: 本地无匹配。点“查阅”向宿主发起查询。
zh.entities.selectText: 选中后列出带有它的全部记忆；需要时，可再查找召回认为相关的其他记忆。
zh.entities.emptyText: 尝试更完整的名称或另一个实体别名。
zh.entities.relatedHint: 召回认为相关、但不带此实体的记忆
zh.remember.title: 存入记忆
zh.remember.description: 任务 Agent 会判断是否值得保存，去重、提炼后写入合适的记忆空间，不占用当前对话。
zh.remember.readOnlyText: 当前部署禁止记忆写入；如需调整，请修改 DSH 的 Mnemon 配置并保存。
zh.remember.placeholder: 输入希望长期保留的背景、偏好、决策或结论。
zh.remember.sessionHint: 当前视图没有可用的模型路由，无法创建独立任务 Agent。
zh.remember.taskAgentHint: 当前 Host 暂时无法创建独立任务 Agent，请刷新状态后重试。
zh.remember.advancedHint: 指定目标记忆空间、分类与重要性
zh.remember.asyncProviderHint: 该记忆空间会等待远程提炼任务完成后再返回真实写入回执。
zh.remember.advancedText: 这些约束同样经过任务 Agent 的去重与回执。
zh.content.title: 记忆内容
zh.content.description: 浏览各记忆空间保存的内容。
zh.content.filterPlaceholder: 按内容或精确 ID 筛选…
zh.content.notice: 查询型 Provider 需要输入关键词后才显示内容。
zh.content.queryRequiredTitle: 查询型记忆空间等待问题
zh.content.queryRequiredText: 输入一个明确查询即可读取 ByteRover 等不提供全量列表的 Provider。
zh.content.emptyText: 清空筛选，或先存入第一条记忆。
zh.overview.providerEnableHint: 未启用的 Provider 可在“插件 → 可组合记忆”的“记忆空间”页面中启用。

en.overview.title: Memory Spaces
en.overview.description: Long-term memory held by Mnemon Native or third-party Providers; active spaces take part in recall.
en.overview.pageDescription: Create and activate Memory Spaces, then inspect storage health and live relation snapshots across providers.
en.overview.interval: Full sync on entry · Click a card to sync on demand
en.overview.fullSyncPending: Waiting for the first full sync
en.overview.directory.description: Each card is one Memory Space; click it to check the connection, and use its switch to include it in recall.
en.overview.reconnectHint: Click the card to reconnect and synchronize this Memory Space
en.overview.metadataTitle: Maintain Memory Space metadata with AI
en.overview.metadataDescription: Select one or more active Memory Spaces. The system reads a small sample through each Provider’s fastest native path, then gives each space to an independent task Agent for its title and description.
en.overview.metadataUnavailable: Temporarily unavailable: no active Agent matches the current memory scope
en.overview.metadataEmpty: There are no active Memory Spaces whose metadata can be maintained by AI.
en.overview.metadataSafety: Only local titles and descriptions are updated. Memory content is never changed, moved, or deleted. Disabling a Provider removes this local metadata with its projection.
en.overview.unsyncedTitle: Memory Space directory is not synchronized
en.overview.unsyncedShort: The Web client and DSH Host are using different contracts. Restart the Host to register existing Stores.
en.overview.unsyncedLong: The Host is still using the previous plugin contract. Restart DSH to rediscover existing Stores; no .db file will be deleted.
en.overview.emptyShort: Create the first space and distill durable context into it.
en.overview.emptyLong: Create a Mnemon Memory Space, or enable a third-party provider on the dsh-mnemon page under Plugins to synchronize its existing namespaces.
en.overview.noActiveText: Enable read access for at least one space to aggregate its live graph here.
en.overview.noContentTitle: Active spaces have no content yet
en.overview.noContentText: Save memories to see their nodes and relations here.
en.overview.createDialogHint: Define this Memory Space and choose its provider here. It reuses services, credentials, and global data locations configured on the dsh-mnemon page under Plugins.
en.overview.createIdentityHint: The name identifies the space; the description guides when the agent writes and recalls it.
en.overview.createPlacementHint: This is an explicit manual creation; choose one enabled Provider. What a task Agent chooses for new spaces is set in Provider for new spaces.
en.overview.createDescriptionPlaceholder: Describe what belongs here and when it should be recalled
en.overview.placementAutomaticHint: Apply data-boundary and capability rules first, then let the agent choose among eligible providers
en.overview.placementUnavailable: Requires a connected conversation aligned with this workspace
en.overview.placementPolicyHint: The host enforces rules. The prompt only guides judgment among eligible candidates.
en.overview.placementPromptPlaceholder: For example: This is collaborative knowledge. Prefer local storage when exact writes are required; otherwise prefer sharing.
en.overview.candidateNativeReady: Official native · follows the active memory scope
en.overview.nativeCliRequired: Needs the Mnemon CLI on this machine; other providers work without it
en.overview.workspaceBinding.optional-overr: Follows the active scope; global location can be customized
en.overview.candidateOpenViking: Include the remote candidate and provide its connection
en.overview.candidateLocal: Local provider · follows the active memory scope
en.overview.candidateRemote: Remote provider · uses the global service configuration
en.overview.providerNativeHint: Official native, local-first storage with the full graph and soft-delete semantics
en.strategy.title: Provider for new spaces
en.strategy.description: How a task Agent picks a Provider when it creates a Memory Space; existing spaces are still chosen by name and description.
en.strategy.modeHint: Applies only to spaces a task Agent creates; you always choose when you create one yourself.
en.strategy.manualHint: Fix one Provider; the Agent cannot override it
en.strategy.automaticHint: Apply hard rules first, then let the task Agent choose an eligible Provider
en.strategy.manualDescription: When no existing space fits, create the new space on this Provider.
en.strategy.automaticDescription: The host enforces data and capability rules. The prompt only guides judgment among eligible candidates.
en.overview.providerOpenVikingHint: Connect an existing OpenViking service under the same Memory Space workflow
en.overview.providerSummary.mnemon-native: Official native, local-first storage with the full graph and soft-delete semantics
en.overview.providerSummary.openviking: Filesystem-shaped shared memory with verified exact writes and semantic retrieval
en.overview.providerSummary.honcho: Cross-session user modelling, peer profiles, dialectic reasoning, and persistent conclusions
en.overview.providerSummary.mem0: Automatic fact extraction, semantic retrieval, reranking, and deduplication
en.overview.providerSummary.hindsight: Knowledge-graph memory with entity resolution, multi-strategy recall, and reflection
en.overview.providerSummary.holographic: Local structured fact memory with trust scoring, entity resolution, and compositional retrieval
en.overview.providerSummary.retaindb: Cloud hybrid vector/BM25 retrieval, user profiles, and typed durable facts
en.overview.providerSummary.byterover: Local-first hierarchical knowledge tree accessed through the brv CLI
en.overview.providerSummary.supermemory: Semantic memory, persistent profiles, conversation ingest, and multi-container recall
en.overview.providerApiKeyOptional: Leave blank when authentication is disabled
en.overview.providerApiKeyKeep: Saved; leave blank to keep unchanged
en.overview.deleteWarning: This permanently deletes the Memory Space and every memory and relation it contains. This cannot be undone.
en.overview.lastStoreDeleteHint: Mnemon must retain at least one native Store. The last Memory Space may be inactive, but it cannot be deleted.
en.overview.disconnectWarning: This only removes the {provider} connection from the DSH Memory Space directory. Memories in the underlying engine remain untouched.
en.overview.snapshotSourcesHint: True relation graphs, edge-free content projections, and query-only spaces remain distinct; missing provider relations are never invented.
en.overview.noVisualText: These providers expose neither enumerable content nor a graph. Open Recall and ask a focused question.
en.overview.selectNodeText: Inspect the exact context for a Memory Space, entity, or memory.
en.graph.aria: Mnemon live memory graph with {nodes} elements and {edges} edges
en.search.title: Recall Memory
en.search.description: Search the active Memory Spaces: direct search returns the stored text, an Agent query answers with citations.
en.search.placeholder: Why did we choose SQLite? What release conventions apply?
en.search.agentAnswerHint: Grounded in the recalled evidence below
en.search.startText: A focused entity, decision, or timeline is more reliable than loading the whole database.
en.search.emptyText: Try a more specific entity, decision, or timeline keyword.
en.search.noRelated: No related nodes found within two hops.
en.entities.title: Entity Explorer
en.entities.description: See how entities connect facts, decisions and context.
en.entities.unsupportedTitle: No active space exposes an entity index
en.entities.unsupportedText: The active providers remain searchable through Recall, but are not presented here as a fabricated entity graph.
en.entities.filterHint: Type to filter the rail locally (Esc to clear).
en.entities.emptyRail: Entities appear here after memories with entity metadata are stored.
en.entities.filterEmpty: No local match. Press Explore to query the host.
en.entities.selectText: Selecting one lists every memory that carries it; Find related memories then adds others recall relates to it.
en.entities.emptyText: Try the full name or another entity alias.
en.entities.relatedHint: Recalled as related, without this entity
en.remember.title: Save to memory
en.remember.description: A task Agent decides whether this is worth keeping, removes duplicates, distills it and writes it to the right Memory Space, outside this conversation.
en.remember.readOnlyText: This deployment disables memory writes. Change and save the DSH Mnemon configuration to enable them.
en.remember.placeholder: Background, preferences, decisions or conclusions worth keeping.
en.remember.sessionHint: No usable model route is available for an independent task Agent.
en.remember.taskAgentHint: The Host cannot currently create an isolated task Agent. Refresh status and try again.
en.remember.advancedHint: Choose the target space, category and importance
en.remember.asyncProviderHint: This Memory Space waits for remote extraction to settle before returning a truthful write receipt.
en.remember.advancedText: Constraints still go through the task Agent’s duplicate check and receipt.
en.content.title: Memory Content
en.content.description: Browse what each Memory Space holds.
en.content.filterPlaceholder: Filter by content or exact ID…
en.content.notice: Query-only Providers show content once you enter a query.
en.content.queryRequiredText: Enter a focused query to inspect providers such as ByteRover that do not expose a complete list.
en.content.emptyText: Clear the filters or save a first memory.
en.overview.providerEnableHint: Turn on more Providers on Memory Spaces’ page under Plugins → dsh-mnemon.
